zara: Quick FYI — onboarding sample-app broken when users enable JSON-mode + tool helpers. Repro below.

paul: Steps?

zara: 1) npx redwood-quickstart 2) registerTool that returns a JSON string 3) call client.chat({ json_mode: true, tools: [...] })
Observed outputs: backtick-wrapped JSON or doubly-escaped strings, e.g. `\`{\\"cmd\\":\\"open\\"}\`` or `\\"{\\"cmd\\":\\"open\\"}\\"`. ajv fails.

ivy: That's the SDK's safeWrap path. It added quoting to avoid markdown breaks but doesn't respect json_mode.

noah: Short fixes: skip safeWrap when json_mode===true or response.meta.format==='structured'; add parseStrictJSON util that returns {ok:false, error, raw} on parse fail so integrators can log the raw payload.

paul: Also saw auth refresh noise locally — multiple concurrent refreshes lead to RetryError: auth refresh failed. Infra should serialize refreshes (single shared promise) and debounce.

zara: I'll put a temp opt-out in quickstart README: REDWOOD_JSON_SAFE_WRAP=false and open a small PR for the helper + tests (backtick, escaped, plain JSON).

ci-bot: ci: PR #4291 opened by zara with SDK helper change; tests queued.

ivy: After merge: bump devex-sdk patch, update sample-app template, post note in #devex. Tagging eng-ml for tool output semantics.
